t: The Bahco Wide Jaw Adjustable Wrench is designed for strong, precise fastening across plumbing, maintenance and installation applications. Manufactured from hardened chrome vanadium steel with a durable phosphate finish, it offers long-lasting performance and corrosion resistance in demanding trade environments. The wide jaw design provides increased opening capacity, while slimline jaws allow easier access in confined spaces. A wide-profile adjustment groove enables smooth knurl operation for quick sizing, and the laser-etched measurement scale helps ensure fast, accurate adjustments. An ergonomic handle enhances grip and control, making the wrench ideal for professional plumbers, fitters and DIY users alike.
